improvements.rationale: A clear meta description improves click-through rates from search results by communicating the core value proposition and free trial offer. Open Graph tags ensure professional, branded previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, or Facebook—critical for B2B audiences. Including the three free searches incentive encourages clicks without overpromising.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Partner"

Subheading: "Meet Gideon — instant answers, voice chat, and expert support for traders and business owners. Try 3 free searches, no card required."
improvements.rationale: The headline positions Gideon as a trusted partner rather than just a tool, appealing to professionals seeking reliable support. The subheading immediately communicates three key benefits (instant answers, voice chat, expert support), identifies the target audience, and removes friction by highlighting the free trial with no payment barrier. This combination builds trust while driving trial conversions.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to choose a membership plan that suits your needs. Plans start from just US$2 per day, billed monthly or annually—with annual billing saving you 30 percent. As a member, you unlock unlimited access to Gideon's AI-powered workspace, voice chat, and professional trade and business support.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in a freemium model—what happens at the paywall. By clearly explaining the transition from free to paid, stating exact pricing, and reinforcing the value unlocked by membership, it reduces anxiety and builds trust, improving conversion rates.
